Ángela Fita Boluda (born 12 July 1999) is a Spanish tennis player. Fita Boluda has a career-high singles ranking by the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) of 214, achieved on 30 June 2025. She also has a career-high WTA doubles ranking of 150, achieved on 8 September 2025. Fita Boluda has won eight singles and 25 doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit . [ 1 ] Career [ edit ] She made her WTA Tour debut 2023 at the Rabat Grand Prix as a lucky loser but was defeated in the first round by Leylah Fernandez in the first round.
